scope: Targeted 25-row non-XLSX/legacy-writer guard; 100 samples/five warmups; strict ABBA rejection and raw per-row descriptive statistics retained; no registered latency claim

protocol.dispersion: sample standard deviation via Rust Welford update
protocol.percentiles: p50 = Rust u64 floor midpoint; p95/p99 = integer nearest-rank
protocol.uncertainty: 95% two-sided Student's t interval for the mean; embedded harness critical-value table with Cornish-Fisher tail
